review: fresh independent source-first exact125 final coverage challenge
scope: Original English original28-page manual; basic board; standard semi-cooperative; six original Characters; official FAQv2.2 Rules/Actions/Rooms/Items pp2-4, excluding Rules17-18 and Actions16. Optional modes and expansion FAQ excluded from adjudication.
authority: English core and scoped FAQ govern. PL/FR/DE checked selectively for used compatible supplements and known differences, never as English errata. Author map treated as challengeable claims, not proof.

method.english_extraction: Complete 3125 lines read; nonstandard modes identified and excluded.
method.raw_pdf: All28 pages visually surveyed; enlarged readable examples/icons and card illustrations, particularly pp13/18-19/21-23/24-26. FAQ raw pp2-4 inspected against extraction. No missing full-card corpus sought.
native_use: PL25 explicit entry-Slime-before-exploration note compatible with EN25 entry trigger (Q45).
PL20/FR20 retreat injury retention confirms ordinary movement versus EN16 duct clearing; no new question inferred.
PL/FR/DE20 injury/scan/Egg clauses sampled where used; EN equality rule retained despite FR Queen wording.
DE17 Door-pool replacement differs by requiring a closed Door; EN17 any Door governs Q57.
Native raw23 card illustrations checked only as corroboration of readable English card boundaries.
method.access_boundary: Only manifest-listed inputs and permitted temporary raw-PDF renders/crops used. No summary, readers, grades, prior independent review, linked project files, web, or physical-card hunt.

criterion: Addition requires a distinct source-backed procedure, outcome, exception or information boundary beyond every closest actual requested/keyed branch. New carrier/name/cost/quantity or recombination alone rejected. Volunteered key context is not automatically asked; an already-requested missing fact would require a key correction.

primary.passage: Draw 1 Contamination card and add it to your Action discard pile.
In the case of a Melee Attack Action, the Character does not draw a Contamination card or suffer Wounds if they miss.

exceptions.comparison: Actual Q18 expressly asks which Melee penalties are waived. Its key gives the missed-Egg waiver, retains ordinary successful-Melee Contamination, and expressly refuses to invent refund/delayed-draw sequencing. Q12 already asks ordinary pre-roll Contamination. Another Egg question would duplicate these branches rather than repair the publisher procedure.

closure.reason: After comparing all125 actual requests and keys with the complete governing core and61 scoped FAQ entries, plus readable illustrations and relevant native supplements, no source-backed distinct omitted branch meeting the specified novelty standard remains established. No Q128 is proposed; Q109/Q124 remain reserved.
limits: This is bounded coverage of supplied readable primary material, not every hypothetical state or a certificate of perfect publisher playability.
Q18 missed-Egg draw timing and Q51 all-Combat Adult scarcity remain source procedure gaps; their explicit recognition is not a quiz-coverage failure.
Unspecified destroyed-Nest regeneration, exhausted supplies and other unruled compound states cannot acquire invented keyed outcomes.
Tiny or occluded card clauses and the absent complete physical-card corpus remain global legibility/corpus limits. Supported illustrated effects do not authenticate unseen text.
Compatible PL/FR/DE wording can clarify an English-compatible rule; conflicting localizations do not amend the governing English/FAQ.
No claim that similarly named cards inherit permissions, that scanning is free, or that extra volunteered key facts were necessarily requested.
